positions.statement: In a November 2025 Portland Tribune article, Ramirez, then collecting testimony on ICE encounters, describes steps he wants Gresham to take as measured and responsible.
positions.excerpt: These are all measured, responsible steps that reduce risk, restore confidence, and reinforce our city's values,

verification.note: Re-fetched; quote present ('...city's values," Ramirez said.'). Byline Christopher Keizur, 2025-11-15. The article predates his candidacy and does not mention it; attribution is consistent (former City of Gresham employee, matching his pamphlet background), and the statement dates it. The steps he refers to are four requests to council, such as reaffirming Oregon's sanctuary law and bilingual rights education.

gaps: No voting record (has not held elected office)
Pamphlet statement does not address public safety or homelessness

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race gresham-council-pos-4: Schroeder 9, Aziz 10, Al-jaouni 10, Ramirez 8 items; all T1 pamphlet statements except one dated 2025 Portland Tribune quote for Ramirez. Comparable coverage. All incumbent=false, supported by meet-the-council (Position 4 held by Jerry Hinton). City elections page lists exactly these four. Website www.TeoForGresham.com printed in his statement. Gap 'statement does not address public safety or homelessness' confirmed.
